hero_desc: Securely manage all your medical lab tests, X-rays, and images in your digital health memory. No more paper, no more lost records.
feat_data_desc: Centralized record keeping for all your health data. Medical centers can upload results directly using your National ID and phone number.
feat_meds_desc: Smart alarms for your medications, including parental notifications once doses are taken to ensure everyone stays on track.
sharing_family_desc: Securely share your health profiles with family members, granting controlled access to specific data points.
sharing_doctor_desc: Doctors can request access to your profile. You maintain full control over who sees your history and results.
ai_analysis_desc: DHM AI interprets complex lab results into easy-to-understand overviews and provides dosage suggestions.
ai_booking_desc: Automatically reschedule doctor appointments based on new test results and your availability.
ai_doc_comm_desc: AI can send results directly to your doctor with a summary, potentially saving you an in-person visit.
more_tele_desc: Seamless video conferencing for virtual consultations from home.
more_wear_desc: Connect smartwatches to collect real-time heart rate and activity levels.
more_emi_desc: Quick-access section for blood type, allergies, and emergency contacts for first responders.
more_refills_desc: Request refills directly through the app and coordinate with local pharmacies.
more_mental_desc: Integration with meditation resources and AI-powered mental health chatbots.
more_insurance_desc: AI-powered help understanding and processing complex insurance claims.
sec_desc: Your medical data is your digital DNA. We protect it with banking-grade fortress technology.
sec_card1_desc: Fully compliant with Global Medical Standards.
sec_card2_desc: Military-grade encryption at rest and in transit.
cta_desc: Join the future of health management where clarity meets uncompromising care.
footer_desc: Digital Health Memory — Your private health record journey.
footer_copy: © 2026 Digital Health Memory. Secure and Private.
